    - Oh. Hello. I'm Cecily. I sing, between the acts. Sorry, did you want someone more... important?
        - *Choice:* Where are you from?
        - *Choice:* Tell me about your singing.
        - *Choice:* What do you dream of?

    - A fishing village on the coast. Tarred cottages, a shingle beach. I learned to sing mending nets with the women, loudest when the wind was up, so nobody could hear me.
    - I came inland on a fish cart at sixteen and scrubbed pots on the Row, until [Lavinia](../npcs/lavinia.md) heard me singing in the gallery queue.
    - Between the acts, while they change the scenery. [Tibb](../npcs/tibb.md) nods from the fly rail when the change is nearly done. On free afternoons [Fulke](../npcs/fulke.md) teaches me the old ballads on the plaza.
    - I taught him my village's sea songs in return. The new one my mother sent, about what the boats see past the shallows at dusk... he made me sing it three times, then sat very still.
    - It's silly. I've only told my mother, in a letter. A royal feast, for the queen: one song from every town of the kingdom, one after another.
    - [Clement](../npcs/clement.md) the herald would have a say. I've walked past him four times meaning to ask. I can sing to a full house, but I can't say one sentence to him.
    - Sorry for keeping you. I mean, thank you. Goodbye!
    - I sang it between the acts. Loud. I didn't look at my shoes once. Well, once.
